recommendedCorrections: READ ONLY current-authority repeatable-read snapshot with final DB-clock expiry; never run checkProductAttr/get.config/writes/allocate identities.
Use explicit all-main-column snake projection plus every legacy transformation; preserve deleted/hidden product readability under product.view as source, not modern detail isDel rejection.
Reconstruct attrs from authoritative active ordinary SKU rows and dimensions; support legacy and TS snapshot shapes, retain stable IDs/unique, return retired rows separately if needed.
Never return assigned or available card passwords in general editor GET. virtual_list=[] plus counts/import-only semantics can roundtrip safely with current save baseline.

Do not erase fixed disk_info on a whole-form resave. Choose manager-authorized fixed-content read or implement a verified preserve-unchanged secret contract before redacting it; trusted copy strips both fixed and inventory secrets.
Persisted custom_form snapshot versus source reset-to-current-system-form must be an explicit parity/correction decision, never accidental data loss.

Missing result can be reconstructed read-only from valid DB dimensions/SKUs. No SKU must be a clearly marked editor template/repair-needed state, not a fabricated persistent saleable identity. Ambiguity/malformed/duplicate/oversized sets should refuse instead of mutating.

Bound complete categories/templates/rows/descriptions/forms/media and check overflow, not silent limit500. Private media authorized and signed only after snapshot; retained canonical identifiers on POST.
Source and current TS description encoding differ: establish normalization or provenance policy; preserve editable bytes and use separate preview sanitizer.
GET completion alone is not full Vue editor migration: generator(0), metadata options, copied SKU/secret policy, draft/defaults, save/unknown recovery and browser flows remain required.

chosenTargetContract.id0AndMissing: Both rejected; no synthetic creation-default GET response.
chosenTargetContract.authority: One RR READ ONLY snapshot; live product.view / exact seed620; final DB-clock expiry.
chosenTargetContract.mainAssociations: Main persisted columns are authoritative; do not union stale relation rows into editor selection.
chosenTargetContract.sku: Authoritative active ordinary SKU+dimensions; explicit old pic/valueN/detail/values and snake核销 projection; single no-SKU may use unpersisted main template without an allocated identity; ambiguous topology409.
chosenTargetContract.cards: No historical card_no/card_pwd or stored snapshot virtual_list; virtual_list=[] plus aggregate available/assigned counts.
chosenTargetContract.fixedContent: Keep actual disk_info under the existing modern product.view detail boundary to avoid clearing it on complete-form save. This is a documented existing access boundary, not a claim of secret-redacted GET.
chosenTargetContract.forms: Match source current-system-form custom_form; separately return stored_custom_form so the persisted snapshot is explicit rather than silently discarded.
chosenTargetContract.copy: No completed trusted localCopy HTTP/copy-flow claim; stripping source unique/card/fixed contents remains required when that flow is connected.
